353:t_1:86.en:
$$シモン$$
「But we threw that kind of common sense away long ago.」

353:t_1:87.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You can't give up, $$ラルク$$.」

353:t_1:88.en:
$$タケル$$
「Where there's hope, light is born. Let's remember that as we fight.」

353:t_1:89.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I-I know... It's their hard work and guts I can't put up with.」

353:t_1:90.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Oh, I get it! You're part of $c after all, $$ラルク$$.」

353:t_1:92.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I... don't like that sort of thing...」

353:t_1:93.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But we don't have much time left...」

353:t_1:94.en:
$$刹那$$
「Our enemies are in deep space, too, besides $$サイデリアル$$ on Earth.」

353:t_1:95.en:
$$桂$$
「$$バアル$$, huh... Just thinking about them gets me down.」

353:t_1:96.en:
$$モーム$$
「Don't, $$桂$$! Everyone's getting fired up!」

353:t_1:97.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Well then, $$万丈$$... Isn't it time you told us?」

353:t_1:99.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A man of your abilities has taken charge of this briefing.」

353:t_1:100.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You must have a trump card to turn things around... or at least a lead, don't you?」

353:t_1:101.en:
$$万丈$$
「...Very sharp, $$ロジャー$$. You've seen right through me.」

353:t_1:103.en:
$$万丈$$
「...We've located the deep-space mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$, which $$サイデリアル$$ seized.」

353:t_1:105.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If we can retake it...」

353:t_1:106.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That means we can get 《$$ヴェーダ$$》 back!」

353:t_1:107.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$... Earth's most advanced quantum computing system...」

353:t_1:108.en:
$$刹那$$
「With its power, we may be able to devise a strategy to counter the Empire.」

353:t_1:109.en:
$$シン$$
「Then let's hurry up and take it back!」

353:t_1:112.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We used every means we had to search for the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$, but couldn't find even a clue...」

353:t_1:113.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$万丈$$... Tell me where that information came from.」

353:t_1:114.en:
$$万丈$$
「Your concerns are justified, $$スメラギ$$. That's precisely why I wanted to handle this information carefully.」

353:t_1:115.en:
$$万丈$$
「The person who brought me this information belongs to $$クロノ$$.」

353:t_1:117.en:
$$シン$$
「The mysterious organization that's intervened in human history from the shadows...」

353:t_1:118.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Since they're helping us, are they one of the Reformists?」

353:t_1:119.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, who monitor humanity's evolution, and the Reformists, who watch over it...」

353:t_1:120.en:
$$万丈$$
「The woman who contacted me as I investigated $$クロノ$$'s true nature said she belonged to neither.」

353:t_1:121.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So there's a third $$クロノ$$ faction...」

353:t_1:123.en:
$$万丈$$
「We didn't speak directly. But she called herself '$$クィーン$$.'」

353:t_1:124.en:
$$マオ$$
「It sounds like a code name...」

353:t_1:125.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, that ain't a code a man would use.」

353:t_1:126.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What matters is that this information could determine the course of the war.」

353:t_1:127.en:
$$万丈$$
「The coordinates were on the edge of the Earth Sphere, in a place with nothing nearby.」

353:t_1:128.en:
$$万丈$$
「I can't vouch for its reliability.」

353:t_1:129.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You're saying it could be a trap...?」

353:t_1:130.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's equally possible that it's true.」

353:t_1:131.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then it's settled. Let's go.」

353:t_1:133.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We've hit rock bottom. If we can't fall any further, we should take even the slightest chance.」

353:t_1:135.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As do I. It's worth the risk.」

353:t_1:137.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The battles ahead will bring hardships unlike anything we've faced before.」

353:t_1:138.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Rank and civilian status won't matter. Whoever offers an opinion, we'll hear it as comrades.」

353:t_1:139.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'll ask again. Does anyone object?」

353:t_1:142.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If it turns out to be a trap, what will we do?」

353:t_1:144.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We'll survive, no matter what... to keep hope alive.」

353:t_1:145.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Understood, Miss $$スメラギ$$. I'll put my faith in that strong resolve, too.」

353:t_1:147.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You're still a bunch with a few screws loose in your heads.」

353:t_1:148.en:
$$ノノ$$
「N-no way! Is there a problem with $$ノノ$$'s head parts?!」

353:t_1:149.en:
$$モーム$$
「$$ノノ$$! It might be me!」

353:t_1:150.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「You two... That's not what he means.」

353:t_1:151.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now we're all of one mind. All that's left is to carry it out.」

353:t_1:152.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All personnel. As soon as we reach the Earth Sphere, we'll begin the operation to retake the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

353:t_1:153.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This battle will be the first step in our counterattack...! Everyone, be ready!」

353:t_1:154.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(If we get $$ヴェーダ$$ back, I might learn...)

353:t_1:155.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(...the connection between $$クロノ$$, $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$, and $$エルガン・ローディック$$.)

353:t_2:4.en:
$$フェルト$$
「...The teams aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ have reported in. They found no hazardous objects or traps.」

353:t_2:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「It looks like the Empire withdrew in a big hurry.」

353:t_2:6.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「They probably didn't expect us to show up after all.」

353:t_2:7.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Their absolute faith in Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ may have delayed planning for contingencies.」

353:t_2:8.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「But $$ストラウス$$ came all the way out to intercept $c, even though they're the Empire's Supreme Commander.」

353:t_2:9.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「They've all but settled the fighting on Earth. They probably came to crush us, the last obstacle.」

353:t_2:10.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I think they also wanted the $$スフィア$$s held by $n, $$クロウ$$, and the others.」

353:t_2:11.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Maybe they're just a figurehead Supreme Commander who got promoted for having a $$スフィア$$.」
